target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft library: RawNode state machine, Node serialized wrapper, log, tracker/quorum, membership and Storage abstraction. Transport, durable writes and application/client completion are caller responsibilities.
protocol_contexts: One raft instance/group, node ID, term, role, log entry term/index and active incoming/outgoing voter configuration.
external_interfaces: RawNode/Node proposal, message, tick, Ready, Advance and configuration application interfaces; Storage.
ownership: Node.run owns serialized processing; RawNode is thread-unsafe and requires caller serialization.
selection_injection: Config supplies storage, IDs, timer parameters and behavioral options.
variants: Single and joint majority voter configuration with learners
PreVote, CheckQuorum, read safe/lease, forwarding and removal options
unknowns: No deployment-specific backend, fault schedule or application completion has been observed.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader replication, per-peer match tracking and current-term quorum commit.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term/role state, vote grant and tally, pre-vote, activity checks and transfer.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Append probing and snapshot/restart reconstruction supply eligible participation.
Applied configuration changes choose incoming/outgoing voters and learner eligibility.
Ready exposes committed entries; completion tracks application progress. Actual state machine is caller-owned.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Library maintains stable/unstable history and deferred support; caller persists it through the Storage/Ready contract.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Library proposal admission and request-correlated ReadState are distinct from application replies.

behaviors.protocol_context: One raft group, local role/term and active progress configuration
behaviors.trigger: MsgProp from local API or forwarding peer
implementation_guards: Leader requires local progress membership and no active leadership transfer; enforces uncommitted payload quota.
Configuration proposals are checked against pendingConfIndex and joint state unless explicitly disabled.
writes: Accepted entries receive current term and consecutive indexes and enter unstable log.
external_effects: Broadcast MsgApp with previous index/term, entries and commit; queue self MsgAppResp through send.
important_branches: Follower forwards only with known leader and forwarding enabled; candidates drop proposals.
Invalid configuration proposal is converted to empty normal entry when validation is enabled; admission is not client completion.
async_boundaries: Ready processing and transport are caller operations.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Propose return is admission/error; committed entries are the subsequent library completion surface.

existing_protections: Append cannot overwrite a committed prefix.
Self acknowledgment is deferred through msgsAfterAppend.

behaviors.protocol_context: Incoming leader term checked by Step, predecessor entry identity and local committed prefix
implementation_guards: Reject incompatible previous index/term.
If predecessor is before committed, acknowledge committed index without appending.
Panic rather than overwrite a committed conflict.
writes: Append conflicting uncommitted suffix and advance local commit to min(leader commit, last new index).
external_effects: Queue success MsgAppResp or rejection with conflict hint through send.
important_branches: Stale leader term is not processed as a current append.
Rejected append drives probing rather than successful match advancement.
async_boundaries: Queued response does not itself establish durable storage.
existing_protections: Response type is deferred by send until caller storage completion.

behaviors.protocol_context: Message carries sending term; append completion also carries last entry index/log term
behaviors.trigger: Election or append reply queued; Ready accepted; Advance or local storage response delivered
reads: msgsAfterAppend, unstable entries, HardState and snapshot.
writes: Ready drains outgoing queues and marks unstable work in progress.
Same-term MsgStorageAppendResp with matching entry identity advances unstable offset.
durable_effects: No disk write is executed by this bridge. Caller must fulfill the storage contract before releasing responses.
external_effects: Sync mode releases remote deferred replies in Ready and stores self replies in stepsOnAdvance.
Async mode puts deferred replies and storage acknowledgment in MsgStorageAppend.Responses.
important_branches: Lower-term append response cannot stabilize log entries; its snapshot can still complete.
A new-term HardState-only append request can attest the current unstable tail.
Apply completion is term zero and intentionally independent of leader term.
async_boundaries: Persistence and response delivery are distinct caller actions.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Delays append support, including self support, before it is counted.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Delays published election votes and filters old storage acknowledgments across term transitions.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Separates committed application completion from entry stabilization.

existing_protections: Storage thread requests must be reliable and ordered per target.
stableTo checks index and log term; Step additionally checks sending term.
unknowns: No external durable backend or crash execution has been inspected.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current leader term and progress record indexed by response sender
behaviors.trigger: Non-rejected MsgAppResp after Step term handling
implementation_guards: Unknown peer response filtered by RawNode/Node; stepLeader requires existing progress.
Old nonzero terms discarded by Step; higher term relinquishes leader role.
writes: RecentActive and monotonically increasing Match/Next in the selected progress record.
important_branches: Rejections adjust probe position with stale rejection checks.
Heartbeat responses mark activity and resume flow but do not set Match.
Snapshot transport status changes probe state but does not by itself set Match.

cross_activity_effects.A3: Acknowledgments, heartbeat responses and rejections manage recovery and flow control.

behaviors.protocol_context: Active voter configuration and current leader term
behaviors.trigger: New append acknowledgment or configuration activation invokes maybeCommit
implementation_guards: Only voter IDs contribute to majority index; joint configuration takes minimum of its two majority indexes.
Advance requires index beyond current committed and matching nonzero current term.
external_effects: On advancement broadcast appends; acknowledgment path releases pending read requests after current-term commitment.
existing_protections: Prior-term entries cannot directly advance commitment through this function.
unknowns: This is only the leader aggregation path; follower append, heartbeat, snapshot and bootstrap set or advance commit through separate paths.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.Step, campaign, role transitions and tracker vote tally
behaviors.protocol_context: Term, local role, voter configuration, prior vote and last log identity
behaviors.trigger: Election tick/Hup, election reply, higher-term message, activity timeout or leadership transfer
implementation_guards: Campaign requires promotable node and no unapplied committed configuration changes; pending snapshot blocks promotion.
Vote grant requires available/repeated vote or future pre-vote and candidate log at least as up to date.
Candidate consumes only its corresponding vote response type; quorum aggregation selects configured voter IDs.
writes: Term, Vote, lead, state, role step/tick functions; reset clears votes and remote progress, transfer, pendingConfIndex and readOnly acknowledgment state.
important_branches: Reset initializes self Match to last log index, remote Match to zero; this is initialization, not an executed durable self reply.
Pre-candidate does not increment term or erase durable vote; real campaign does.
Higher-term pre-votes and granted pre-vote responses have special handling; active lease can reject disruptive campaigns.
Won election becomes leader and appends current-term empty entry.
CheckQuorum can step down at same term; transfer waits for caught-up voter, sends TimeoutNow and times out/aborts.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Resets eligible match evidence and starts current-term log advancement; old nonzero-term replies are filtered.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Pending readOnly acknowledgment state is replaced, but pendingReadIndexMessages and already-produced readStates are not cleared by reset.

existing_protections: Actual self-vote is counted via deferred response after storage contract.
Log entries and committed index are retained through reset.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied configuration entry, incoming/outgoing voters and learners
behaviors.trigger: Caller applies configuration change or snapshot/startup restores ConfState
implementation_guards: Simple change permits at most one voter difference and cannot operate in joint state.
EnterJoint retains outgoing majority; LeaveJoint removes it and activates staged learners.
Checker enforces progress presence and learner/voter separation.
writes: Replace active Config and copied ProgressMap; preserve existing match records, initialize new progress Match to zero.
important_branches: Removal retains progress while still outgoing voter; full removal deletes it.
Optional StepDownOnRemoval controls immediate leader role loss; local membership still gates proposals.
Applying new quorum can immediately call maybeCommit.
AutoLeave proposal is triggered on applied progress when leader.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which registered Match values are aggregated and may commit an existing suffix.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes election eligibility and can relinquish leader role.
cross_activity_effects.A3: New peers start with zero Match and are probed.

existing_protections: Configuration activation is application-driven; pending index limits subsequent configuration proposals.

behaviors.protocol_context: Restarted node or follower receiving snapshot; compacted prefix and saved state
implementation_guards: loadState checks saved commit lies in current log bounds.
Snapshot at/below committed ignored; recipient must be in snapshot configuration.
Matching snapshot entry fast-forwards commit without replacing log; otherwise restore log and configuration.
Bootstrap requires nonempty peers and empty Storage.
writes: Reconstruct log boundary, HardState term/vote/commit and configuration; become follower.
Bootstrap appends term-one configuration entries, marks committed and activates peers but leaves application work outstanding.
durable_effects: Storage is caller supplied; MemoryStorage is in-memory and is not durable by itself.
important_branches: Snapshot replacement creates unstable snapshot and blocks promotion/application of following entries until completion.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reconstructs established prefix and participation without preserving prior leader peer-match observations.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Startup enters follower role; restored membership determines eligibility.
cross_activity_effects.A6: Snapshot plus stable log and HardState are reconstruction inputs.

unknowns: Backend-specific crash consistency and compaction schedules remain outside the read paths.

behaviors.protocol_context: Committed, applying, applied and stable offsets for the local log
behaviors.trigger: Ready delivery and Advance or MsgStorageApplyResp
implementation_guards: Application work is bounded by committed index, in-flight size and snapshot exclusion.
Async mode additionally bounds entries by locally stable offset.
writes: acceptReady tracks applying; completion advances applied (using max to retain monotonic progress).
external_effects: CommittedEntries or MsgStorageApply expose application work.
important_branches: Sync mode may return unstable committed entries with the same Ready; caller ordering remains required.
Committed application response uses term zero and can be consumed after role/term change.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Applied progress can initiate automatic exit from joint configuration.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Application of a proposal is distinct from Propose admission; application-specific replies are caller-owned.

unknowns: No application state machine or client response implementation is attributed to this library.

facts.meaning: A progress record currently stores a local matched-prefix index for one peer. Successful MsgAppResp can increase it; reset separately initializes the local peer to lastIndex and remote peers to zero, and membership initializes new peers to zero. The stored number alone is not an observation of durable completion.

identity.record: Progress lifetime within leader role and active configuration

facts.validity_context: Meaning depends on current leader term, record origin, and active voter configuration. Term/role reset replaces progress; configuration changes may retain, remove, or initialize it.
facts.durability: Volatile local tracking, not a persisted certificate.
facts.recovery: Rebuilt by initialization and subsequent replies rather than restored as remote support.
unknowns: Durability attribution of any individual reply requires executing its producer, caller persistence and delivery in the same history.
Initialization of self Match must not be conflated with the storage-delayed self MsgAppResp path.

surfaces.reason: Sending-term and log-entry identity protect different stages; next discriminator can execute delayed completion across an actual term transition.
Source reveals separate pre-commit queue, acknowledgment map and Ready result queue; no single request lifecycle or candidate is yet mapped.
Quorum change can consume retained matches without a new acknowledgment. Legality depends on committed configuration application, which a future check must construct.

surfaces.entry_point: Caller storage worker and application/client response
surfaces.reason: This library exposes contracts, storage requests and application work. The Node wrapper is in-repository and mapped; no durable application backend has been attributed.

formation.explanation: RawNode.Propose creates MsgProp; Node.run serializes the equivalent state-machine work, while RawNode callers must serialize their own calls. A follower forwards only to a known leader; a candidate drops it. The leader checks membership, transfer and quota, assigns current term/index, appends unstable entries and broadcasts MsgApp anchored by predecessor index/term. The follower checks term and predecessor, rejects conflicts or appends a suffix without overwriting committed history, and queues MsgAppResp. send defers append/election support, including self support, through the Ready storage boundary. After legal caller persistence and delivery, leader response handling records sender Match. The active voter quorum aggregates these values (both majorities in joint configuration); maybeCommit additionally requires a current-term entry beyond committed. Commit is recorded in raftLog and HardState and propagated by append or heartbeat, whose commit is capped by recipient Match. Ready exposes committed application work; async application is additionally bounded by local stabilization. Actual client reply is outside this library and Propose success does not guarantee commitment.

context.explanation: Startup reads log boundaries, HardState and ConfState, reconstructs configuration and becomes follower. Bootstrap is a separate empty-storage initialization that creates committed configuration entries for the caller to persist/apply. Campaign requires a voter with no pending snapshot and no unapplied committed configuration change. Pre-vote can precede real candidacy; real candidacy increments term and records self-vote, but counting the self response waits on storage processing. Vote grant checks vote availability and candidate last term/index. Candidate tally counts configured voters and both joint majorities. Winning enters leader role and appends an empty current-term entry. Step processes message terms before role handlers: ordinary higher terms step down, lower terms are discarded with explicit pre-vote, stale leader and storage-completion exceptions. CheckQuorum can remove authority at the same term; transfer pauses proposals, catches up an eligible peer and issues TimeoutNow with timeout/abort paths. Configuration activation may remove/demote leadership depending on configured behavior.

connection.explanation: Authority reset keeps log/committed history but clears vote tally, remote progress, transfer and readOnly acknowledgment state; it initializes self Match from the retained last index, so Match is not intrinsically a fresh durable acknowledgment. Old-term network append/election replies cannot update current-role support. Local append stabilization requires both sending-term validity and entry index/log-term match. Snapshot completion and committed application are allowed to survive term change because their objects are committed state; application responses deliberately carry term zero. The committed prefix constrains future append replacement and election log freshness; committing an entry in the new leader term advances eligible prior entries as part of the prefix. Membership activates during application, retains surviving progress, initializes new members to zero and changes the quorum consumer. Pending ReadIndex messages waiting for first current-term commit survive reset, whereas readOnly acknowledgment maps are replaced; release re-enters the read protocol after current-term commit. Already-produced ReadStates also survive until Ready consumption. Safe reads correlate request contexts with heartbeat acknowledgments and configured voter quorum; singleton and lease-based paths differ. Their application-visible linearizability remains untested.

open_details: ReadIndex request context uniqueness, repeated context behavior and configuration transition interactions need focused mapping before any Candidate depends on them.
MemoryStorage compaction/reconstruction and real durable backend behavior have not been explored beyond interface and startup paths.
Detailed inflight window/rejection recovery schedules remain unexpanded.
Ready field comments and doc.go differ in how they describe same-batch persistence/send concurrency; a concrete check must state its API mode and use a legal conservative ordering.
core_overview.rationale: The representative normal proposal and authority paths, including membership, storage, recovery and library completion boundaries, have been read through their actual producers and consumers. This is a scoped mechanism map, not an execution result or correctness finding.
